1. 开发者与用途\n循济由 GPDdev 个人开发，与同济大学、体育部门、微信:
1. Developer and purpose
TongjiTap is a personal project by GPDdev, unaffiliated with Tongji University, its sports departments, WeChat or music providers. Loop provides tap sequences and color triggers; Stride provides music and speed gestures; Relay operates the Wi-Fi toggle based on screen marker and distance changes.
2. 辅助功能与屏幕\n你主动授权并开始后，Loop 可以模拟点击和返回。颜色检:
2. Accessibility and screen data
After you authorize and start it, Loop can simulate taps and Back. Color detection and Relay capture the screen through accessibility. Screenshot imports use the system picker. Images, marker analysis and distance OCR are processed in device memory without saving copies or uploading screenshots. Relay monitors the configured running regions in WeChat and reads switch nodes in System UI, not chat text. Stop or revoke accessibility at any time.
3. 音乐与网络\n本地音频由系统文件选择器授权，保存访问许可以供后台播放。导入:
3. Music and network
Local audio uses system-granted file access, retained for background playback. Public NetEase playlist imports and streaming contact the music provider, which receives normal request information; mobile data may be used. No login, subscription bypass or NCM decryption is provided. Availability depends on regional, rights and provider restrictions.
4. OCR 与本地数据\n里程识别使用内置 ML Kit 模型，无需首次下载模:
4. OCR and local data
Distance recognition uses the bundled ML Kit model, with no first-use model download. Image processing is on-device; ML Kit sends performance and usage metrics to Google under its SDK privacy terms. Settings, library, language, theme, tutorial progress and launch count stay in private app storage. No ads. Uninstalling or clearing data removes settings.
5. 网络切换与设备风险\n需自行开启 Wi-Fi 和移动数据、保存 TJ-WI:
5. Network switching and device risks
Enable Wi-Fi and mobile data yourself, save TJ-WIFI credentials and enable auto-connect. The app does not read, store or submit campus passwords. Switching may consume mobile data or interrupt connections. Vendor panels, resolution, orientation, layout changes and popups can cause failures or incorrect taps. Calibrate first, keep the screen visible and avoid payments, chats and sensitive pages.
6. 第三方规则与运动记录\n自动操作以及利用定位、计步或里程异常产生记录，可能:
6. Third-party rules and exercise records
Automation or records generated from location, step or distance anomalies may violate school or platform rules. No distance gain, valid score, approval or immunity from account restrictions is guaranteed. Follow applicable rules and do not present anomalous records as proof of real exercise. Features and notices imply no school or platform authorization and do not waive applicable liability.
7. 控制与联系\n运行均需主动开始；锁屏、屏幕方向变化及异常时停止自动操作，不:
7. Control and contact
Automation starts only on your command and stops on lock, screen changes or errors. It does not auto-start after reboot. Wi-Fi stays in its current state after stopping; restore it manually as needed. More contains tutorials, source and updates. QQ group: 934139029. Project: https://github.com/GPDdev/TongjiTap.
辅助功能可模拟点击、返回、打开快捷设置。开启颜色检测或跃点后可读取屏幕截图；跃点:
Accessibility can simulate taps, Back and Quick Settings. Color detection and Relay can capture the screen; Relay reads Wi-Fi switch nodes in System UI.

Actions require your manual start. Stop or disable the service at any time. Music does not require accessibility.

Find TongjiTap in system accessibility settings and enable it yourself.
